import resource, subprocess, sys, time, os
def run(path, vlimit_kib=512*1024):
    def limit():
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (vlimit_kib*1024, vlimit_kib*1024))
    t0 = time.time()
    with open(path,'rb') as f, open(path+'.out','wb') as o:
        p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '/app/submission/bridge.py'], stdin=f, stdout=o,
                             stderr=subprocess.PIPE, preexec_fn=limit)
        err = p.communicate()[1]
    dt = time.time()-t0
    ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    print('%s: exit=%d time=%.2fs peak_child_rss=%.0f MiB stderr=%r' % (path, p.returncode, dt, ru.ru_maxrss/1024, err[:200]))
run('worst.json')
run('padded.json')

a=json.load(open('worst.json.out')); b=json.load(open('padded.json.out'))
print('same result:', a==b, 'statuses:', {s['status'] for s in a['streams']}, 'streams:', len(a['streams']))
